variants.headline: Request for more shipping refused
variants.body: The home world has refused the colony's request for more shipping. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Home world declines route expansion request
variants.body: A colonial request for additional shipping has been rejected by the home world. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: No assent to the colony's shipping plea
